description: Send store events to Segment automatically
name: Segment

images.title: Store events in Segment
images.description: Store events arrive in Segment as track calls with readable names, like Order Paid, and the full record as properties.

images.title: Send only the events you need
images.description: Choose events by model: orders, carts, customers, products, subscriptions and more. Unchecked events are never sent.

images.title: Connected in a few minutes
images.description: Copy your write key from Segment, paste it in the app settings and pick your region, US or EU.

images.title: Switch from the built-in integration
images.description: Install the app and turn off the built-in integration in one step. Events keep the same names and data.
